contract: Preview the existing miniprogram-demo sources directly. Open the merged training home first, preserve four tabs and original page logic, support editing cards/plans and actual records, and keep browser records separate from WeChat storage. Changes saved to source files refresh the preview.

accessibility.evidence: Exercised native buttons, form fields and selectors through browser automation, checked keyboard Tab reaches a control; interactive WXML text has button roles and Enter/Space handlers. Inputs have accessible names, focus styles are visible and status/error containers use live status/alert roles. Existing product color tokens are preserved; this is not a full WCAG audit.

responsive.evidence: Rendered and inspected desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844/375x812 captures. Mobile hides the preview sidebar and uses the full viewport; both mobile sizes have no horizontal document overflow. The bottom tabs remain visible while page content scrolls.

loading.evidence: Delayed the source bundle response and observed the stable loading placeholder before the actual page rendered.

empty.evidence: A clean isolated browser context displays the growth-page empty training history and offers free backfill.

error.evidence: Attempted to confirm a new card before checking the acknowledgement. The original page displayed its validation message; checking and saving then succeeded.

partial.evidence: Saved actual breath-set amounts [5,2,null], returned to the training home, then checked growth and summary. All views use one persisted partial session.

success.evidence: Created and confirmed a Chinese-named card, saved a weekday plan, and verified persistence after refresh. Imported an actual image using the file picker and verified it still loaded from IndexedDB after refresh.

permission.reason: This local browser host uses a user-triggered file picker for media. Native WeChat camera/album permission dialogs are outside this browser preview and require WeChat developer-tools or real-device testing.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop preview shell and the actual merged training page, with working sidebar and native-style four-tab navigation.
Full-width mobile training home showing partial progress and entry to training materials; no horizontal page overflow.
Narrow mobile training home retains readable calendar, actual progress, primary action and bottom tabs.
Actual partial session appears in growth and the period summary generated by the original page handlers.
